client_browser_review.regression_policy: Stable component is provisionally regressed when its nominal 95% comparison interval excludes parity in the slower direction and median loss exceeds 3%. Five baseline runs precede all candidates; relative MAD > 1% or range/median > 6% flags insufficient precision without widening thresholds.

primary.interpretation: Baseline/candidate selected Score, equivalent geometric-mean duration cost. Arithmetic Score decrease is stated separately.

qualifications: This selected headless one-iteration JS/DOM/layout/event-loop workload is not an official full Speedometer score, desktop/GPU responsiveness, steady-state or isolated-JavaScript result.
Measured selected geometric-mean duration cost is small and consistent; no client speedup, parity or overall browser acceptance claim.
All 43 component medians are below the fixed 3% material-loss threshold. Five Phase0 flags and four marginal component intervals permitting greater losses remain visible.

CPU and memory are sampled; CPU5 busy minus sampled owned CPU is approximate and does not identify foreign work.
